estimands.macro_accuracy: Task-equal-weighted (macro) accuracy: the mean over tasks of each task's trial-mean pass rate; every task weighs the same regardless of how many trials it has.
estimands.micro_accuracy: Trial-pooled (micro) accuracy within a benchmark/arm: successes / trials. Tasks with more repeated trials weigh proportionally more.
estimands.outcomes: Truncation / cap-exhausted / empty / grader-error / completed counts derived only from fields actually present on each trial (explicit flags, finish_reason, recorded output caps, final_answer, failure_class); finish_reason and failure_class are never fabricated for archives that do not record them, and grader_error is counted only when failure_class literally equals "grader_error".
estimands.paired_comparisons: Keyed task-cluster paired comparisons on exact (benchmark, task_id, trial) identity; repeated matched trials are averaged within tasks; Holm step-down correction over the comparison family.
estimands.token_ratio_tahoe_over_classic: tahoe token spend / classic token spend for the same scope; null when the classic spend is zero.
estimands.token_sums: Exact sums of recorded input/output/total token counts over all trials in scope.
estimands.total_spend_per_success: sum(total_tokens over ALL attempts, failures included) / number of successes; null (undefined) when there are zero successes.

manifest.finish_reason_policy: archived stage-1 trials carry no finish_reason; none is fabricated; cap evidence is output_tokens-derived only
